newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Antarctica NE initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Antarctica NE initiated.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was initiating coverage of Antarctica Nordeste, a subsidiary of Brazil's brewery Antarctica, with a buy recommendation as a medium to long-term investment.
-- It said in a report the firm's multiples are much lower than for its main domestic competitor Brahma and international competitors.
-- "We are forecasting P/E (price/earnings) and P/CF (price/cash flow) multiples of 7.2 and 4.2 respectively for 1996, considerably lower than Brahma's P/E of 18.0 and P/CF of 10.6," it said.
-- The report also said strong growth prospects boost Antarctica Nordeste, which is responsible for the main consumer centers in northeastern Brazil.
-- Antarctica Nordeste shares were not traded on the Sao Paulo bourse on Tuesday.
